## Activity

River Outreach recorded 45 captures during January 2023. Activity was delivered through the planned session arrangements, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. The recorded activity provides the basis for reviewing image quality and subsequent grading outcomes. No additional operational issue was noted in the information available for this reporting period.

## Image quality

Image quality review identified 5 ungradable captures. This represented an ungradable rate of 11.1 per cent of all captures. The result should be monitored alongside future site activity to determine whether the level remains consistent. Where appropriate, routine feedback from image review can support continued attention to image acquisition and help maintain a suitable standard for grading.

## Grading

Grading identified 7 referable results among the reviewed captures. The median lag between capture and grading was 0, indicating that the midpoint of the reported grading interval was recorded without delay. These results should continue to be managed through the established referral and follow-up arrangements. Overall, the report records completed activity, a defined level of ungradable material, and timely grading during January 2023.
